description: 2N3904 general-purpose NPN transistor, TO-92, emitter-base-collector pinout

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: exact match for 2N3904 (Diotec Semiconductor), Mouser part 637-2N3904, description 'Bipolar Transistors - BJT BJT, TO-92, 40V, 200mA, NPN'.
Diotec 2N3904 datasheet (fetched 2026-09-30, Version 2026-03-10): the datasheet is titled 2N3904 - the device type this part is. Diotec's order code for it (mpn) is the same bare '2N3904'.
Diotec 2N3904 datasheet (fetched 2026-09-30, Version 2026-03-10), Maximum ratings table: Collector-Emitter voltage VCEO = 40 V.
Diotec 2N3904 datasheet (fetched 2026-09-30, Version 2026-03-10), header block and Maximum ratings table: Ptot = 625 mW.

Diotec 2N3904 datasheet (fetched 2026-09-30), page 1 device schematic drawn next to the package outline: pin 1 = Emitter (E), pin 2 = Base (B), pin 3 = Collector (C) - i.e. emitter, base, collector reading pin 1 to pin 3. This is the current datasheet revision; an older secondary listing (aggregator, not the manufacturer) gives a C-B-E reading for a 2N3904 - it was not used as evidence and may reflect a stale or misread revision. The footprint's own emitter/base/collector pin order matches this drawing exactly.

why: Diotec's 2N3904 (device type 2N3904, sold under the order code '2N3904'), from a well-known transistor manufacturer, well stocked at Mouser (43097 units), at a competitive price, and its current datasheet states an emitter-base-collector pinout that matches this board's TO-92_Inline footprint. It was chosen while the fit check still compared the circuit's part number with the entry's mpn, which ruled out onsemi's 2N3904BU (a cheaper, higher-stock bulk-packed order code for the same type, same pinout per onsemi 2N3904/D datasheet, Rev. 9/Oct 2024 marking diagram: 1 Emitter, 2 Base, 3 Collector). The check now compares specs.type, so 2N3904BU is eligible too; this choice has not been re-evaluated against it.
